response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), comparisons AS (SELECT transref, ordertypedist, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transref, ordertypedist, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, short_interest_ratio FROM comparisons ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The order type mix average gives each matched transaction equal weight. AVG ignores missing values; a missing or zero comparison average produces a missing ratio.
